name: 요한
motion_summary: Eternal Return Johann Salvation Sanctuary: dark blue-haired gentle-eyed cleric in blue-black/gold vestments and cross pendant as identity, no generic angry face. R pushes enemies outward and creates a healing sanctuary. Exact 12 poses: ready; bow head; bring palms together; lift forearms; open arms outward; white-gold cross halo rises behind upper body without obscuring face; extend palms down as circular gold-white sanctuary expands at feet; rotate torso left and pulse healing; rotate right and second soft pulse; draw hands back; lower arms as halo dissolves; ready. No summoned extra people. Warm white/gold sacred light with subtle pale-blue edge, crisp pixels.
visual_review: 푸른 눈·성직복을 유지하고 기도, 양팔 전개, 회복 파동과 회수가 변화합니다. 12셀 배치와 얼굴 가시성을 확인했습니다.
